_comment: Non-league competitions. The field is every club of the named tiers that exists in the database; amateur rounds outside the snapshot are not modelled. Round names and legs are derived from the field size: the last three rounds are quarter-final, semi and final, and `two_legged` names the rounds played over two legs.

ESCUP.label: Copa del Rey
ESCUP.note: 126 clubs in the real 2025-26 edition; the field here is the Spanish clubs present in the snapshot. The four Supercopa clubs' round-of-32 entry and the two-legged preliminary round are not modelled separately.
